arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Lerner stated the case involves thermal imaging of a home without a warrant.
Lerner asserted this constitutes an impermissible search under the Fourth Amendment.
Lerner described the home as the basic refuge for all citizens.
Dreeben explained thermal imaging senses heat gradients on the exterior of a surface.
